sloka: कदा समभिधानन्ति मामका राघवम् शराः ।वसन्ते पुष्पितम् मत्ता भ्रमरा इव पादपम् ॥६-२४-३८॥।।
transliteration: kadā samabhidhānanti māmakā rāghavam śarāḥ ।vasante puṣpitam mattā bhramarā iva pādapam ॥6-24-38॥।।

translations.english: "Just as drunken bees reach the trees with blossoms in spring when will my arrows attack Rama?"
